answer_1.quote: For each mental state trajectory, we prompt GPT-4-Turbo to generate the dialogue and background of the scenario

answer_4.quote: four human annotators evaluate each scenario on three dimensions using a 5-point scale: consistency (alignment with the designed mental state trajectory), coherent (the five scenarios within each social context form a coherent storyline), and authenticity (naturalness of the scenario and conversations)
answer_4.guideline: evaluation on a 5-point scale for consistency, coherent, and authenticity
